classification.difficultyReason: Read each radius and select the positive or negative semicircle formula, including fractional and surd radii.

content.prompt: Write the equation of these semicircles.

spec.description: Upper semicircle with labelled intercepts and no filled endpoint markers; equal axis units.

answer.worked:
The radius is $3$ and the semicircle is above the $x$-axis.
$$\begin{aligned}y&=\sqrt{3^2-x^2}\\y&=\sqrt{9-x^2}\end{aligned}$$

spec.description: Lower semicircle with surd intercept labels and no filled endpoint markers; equal axis units.

answer.worked:
The radius is $\sqrt{3}$ and the semicircle is below the $x$-axis.
$$\begin{aligned}y&=-\sqrt{(\sqrt{3})^2-x^2}\\y&=-\sqrt{3-x^2}\end{aligned}$$

spec.description: Upper semicircle with stacked fractional intercept labels and no filled endpoint markers; equal axis units.

answer.worked:
The radius is $\frac15$ and the semicircle is above the $x$-axis.
$$\begin{aligned}y&=\sqrt{\left(\frac15\right)^2-x^2}\\y&=\sqrt{\frac1{25}-x^2}\end{aligned}$$

spec.description: Lower semicircle with stacked fractional intercept labels and no filled endpoint markers; equal axis units.

answer.worked:
The radius is $\frac32$ and the semicircle is below the $x$-axis.
$$\begin{aligned}y&=-\sqrt{\left(\frac32\right)^2-x^2}\\y&=-\sqrt{\frac94-x^2}\end{aligned}$$
